name: claude-code-mods
description: Claude Mods and the tools to build them: a builder skill, then mods.

plugins.name: mod-builder
plugins.description: A skill that plans, writes, validates and reviews a Claude Mod. Every idea must justify each process, file, network, model or UI capability it requests: plan first, smallest $ surface, validator output pasted, a five-line threat model. A brainstorm mode checks ideas against every mod already on GitHub.

plugins.name: fable-pin
plugins.description: Pins every subagent to the fable model by rewriting agent.spawn, with /fable-pin on, off and status. Reach L0: its own store and one command, nothing else.

plugins.name: cache-warm
plugins.description: Keeps the 1-hour prompt cache warm for a window you set (/keepwarm 6h): after 50 idle minutes it sends one cache-shared fork so your comeback is a read, not an 80x re-write, and stops itself the moment a ping reads cold. Reach L2: one $.model.fork per idle stretch, its own store, a status slot.
